from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics for one company extracted from its 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as identified in the document")
    retained_earnings: float | None = Field(description="Retained earnings value; negative if deficit, positive if earnings")
    retained_earnings_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars'")
    total_stockholders_equity: float | None = Field(description="Total stockholders' equity value; can be negative if deficit")
    total_stockholders_equity_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale: 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Quarter-end date in YYYY-MM format")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_metrics: list[CompanyFinancialMetrics]
